purpose: Single ledger of every bug fixed, its root cause, and a prevention rule. Agents: READ 'rules_for_agents' BEFORE touching UI routes, state handling, or index.html — and ADD an entry here for every bug you fix.
rules_for_agents: STATE: anything the user configures (provider, keys) MUST survive a server restart. It is persisted in .harness-state.json via _ai_state.persist_section / load_section. Never move configured state back to memory-only. (BF-010)

AFTER EVERY SERVER RESTART: verify the saved provider still resolves — `curl /api/models` (no params) must return 200, not 503. If it fails, restore the provider before handing back to the user. (BF-010)
CHAT reads the SAVED provider, not inline query params. Test/Fetch can pass keys inline, but chat needs the provider saved (auto-save on Fetch models handles this). (BF-005)

CSS ANIMATION: never set a base `opacity:0` on an element whose only visible state comes from a keyframe animation without `animation-fill-mode: both` (or forwards) — the element snaps back to invisible when the animation ends. (BF-006)
DUCKDUCKGO: the /html/ endpoint returns 302 to automated clients. Always keep the /lite/ fallback and the single-quote-tolerant regexes in harness/mcp/builtin.py. (BF-003)
STARLETTE/FASTAPI: use `TemplateResponse(request, name)` — the legacy `TemplateResponse(name, context)` form crashes with 'unhashable type: dict' on starlette>=1.x. (BF-001)
LLMClient: several tests construct it via `__new__` and set attributes manually. Access optional attributes with `getattr(self, 'attr', default)`. (BF-004)
TEMPLATE: index.html is a Jinja2 template — never write literal `{{` (e.g. in placeholder text) or Jinja will try to evaluate it. (BF-001 era)

ASYNC IN ROUTES: FastAPI routes already run inside an event loop. To run an async tool synchronously, run it in a worker thread via asyncio.run inside that thread — never asyncio.run directly in the route. (BF-008)
VERIFY BEFORE DONE: for any index.html change run `pytest` AND `curl localhost:8080/` sanity checks; for chat rendering changes, also test the renderer against headings/lists/links/code/XSS. (BF-007)
DEV DEPS: new test imports (respx, pytest-asyncio) must be added to pyproject [project.optional-dependencies].dev the same commit they are used. (BF-009)

MODELS: never hardcode cloud model IDs — providers deprecate them (Groq dropped llama-3.3-70b-versatile by 2026-09). Model resolution must stay auto-discovered from the live /models list and persisted. (BF-011)

TOOL-CALL MARKUP: LLMs may wrap tool calls in <tool_call>…</tool_call> XML (Qwen/Anthropic style) instead of the documented JSON. Always strip this markup AND any raw tool-call JSON payload from the final visible reply (harness.ui.routes_chat._clean_final_text); never let it leak into chat or session history. (BF-013)

GENERATION LIMITS: max_tokens and context_window are user-tunable and persisted in the ai_provider state. chat() must pass max_tokens to the endpoint, _fit_context must honor context_window, and when the model exhausts its tool rounds, force one explicit 'give the final answer' turn instead of surfacing the empty-answer fallback. Never hardcode a small output ceiling. (BF-014)

bugs.symptom: GET / crashed: TypeError 'unhashable type: dict' from jinja2 LRUCache; test_index failed.
bugs.root_cause: Legacy Starlette call TemplateResponse(name, context) — starlette 1.x interprets the first arg as `request`, so the context dict became the template-name cache key.
bugs.prevention: See rules_for_agents[5]; also never write literal {{ }} inside the Jinja template.

bugs.root_cause: Fallback max(1, len//4) forced a minimum of 1 even for empty input.
bugs.prevention: Boundary inputs (empty/None) must be handled before generic fallbacks.

bugs.symptom: Free web_search MCP returned 0 results ('are the free MCPs working?').
bugs.root_cause: duckduckgo.com/html/ answers 302 to automated clients; plus DDG Lite uses single-quoted attributes the first regex missed.
bugs.fix: Search tries lite.duckduckgo.com first, falls back to html/; added quote-agnostic regexes for both markups (parse_ddg_html).
bugs.prevention: See rules_for_agents[4]; any scraped endpoint needs a verified live test, not just unit fixtures.

bugs.symptom: 16 LLM client tests failed with AttributeError: 'LLMClient' object has no attribute 'api_key'.
bugs.root_cause: Tests construct LLMClient via __new__ + manual attributes; the new api_key attribute didn't exist on those instances.
bugs.prevention: See rules_for_agents[6]; when adding instance attributes, grep tests for __new__ usage.

bugs.symptom: Chat returned 503 while Test connection & Fetch models succeeded; UI showed 'ai endpoint offline'.
bugs.root_cause: Test/Fetch used inline base_url+key, but /api/chat read only the SAVED provider state, which was still the default local Ollama URL. User never clicked Save.
bugs.fix: (1) Fetch models auto-saves the provider; (2) chat falls back to Keys-tab env keys (OPENROUTER_API_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY, …) with per-provider default models; (3) 503 now carries actionable guidance; (4) UI warns when a real key is pasted into the env-var field.
bugs.prevention: See rules_for_agents[2]; any new consumer of provider config must read via _ai_state.get_state(), and saving must be verified end-to-end (test → fetch → chat).

bugs.symptom: AI chat responses appeared then instantly disappeared.
bugs.root_cause: .message had base opacity:0 with a fade-in keyframe but no animation-fill-mode — after 220ms the element reverted to opacity:0.
bugs.prevention: See rules_for_agents[3]; after any chat CSS change, send a real message and confirm it stays visible.

bugs.symptom: Raw markdown notation visible in chat (headings, [link](url) brackets, list markers); links looked separated from text.
bugs.root_cause: Only naive **bold**/`code` substitution existed; no real markdown rendering.
bugs.fix: Dependency-free renderMarkdown() — escapes HTML first (XSS-safe), then renders headings, lists, blockquotes, hr, fenced+inline code, [text](url) anchors, bare-URL autolink; styled in .msg-bubble.
bugs.prevention: See rules_for_agents[9]; renderer changes need the node-extraction test battery (headings/lists/links/code/XSS).

bugs.symptom: RuntimeWarning: coroutine '_run_tool' was never awaited during tool calls.
bugs.root_cause: asyncio.run attempted inside a running event loop; coroutine created before the fallback decided.
bugs.fix: _run_tool_sync checks asyncio.get_running_loop(); inside a loop it runs asyncio.run inside a worker thread.

bugs.symptom: pytest collection error: ModuleNotFoundError 'respx'; async tests skipped (unknown mark).
bugs.root_cause: Test-only imports missing from dev extras.

bugs.symptom: 'ai endpoint offline' error kept returning after every server restart / code change, forcing the user to reconnect the AI repeatedly.
bugs.root_cause: Provider config and Keys-tab keys lived only in process memory. Every restart (deploy, code change, crash) wiped them; the UI then fell back to the default local Ollama URL and showed offline.
bugs.fix: State now persists to .harness-state.json (gitignored): _ai_state loads/saves the 'ai_provider' section on import/update; routes_keys loads/saves the 'keys' section and re-exports them to os.environ at startup. Tests redirect the file via HARNESS_STATE_FILE (tests/conftest.py).
bugs.prevention: See rules_for_agents[0] and [1]. Any new user-configured state must be added as a persisted section, and post-restart verification is mandatory.

bugs.symptom: Chat returned 502 right after saving a cloud provider (e.g. Groq) — even though Test connection passed.
bugs.root_cause: Provider saved without pressing Fetch models → no model selected → chat fell back to the local-only default 'llama3' (Groq returned HTTP 404). A first attempt at hardcoded per-provider defaults was itself stale: Groq deprecated llama-3.3-70b-versatile (verified 2026-09-12 — their lineup is now qwen3.8/gpt-oss etc.).
bugs.fix: routes_chat auto-discovers: when no model is saved, _maybe_resolve_model fetches the endpoint's live /models list, picks a chat-capable model (skips whisper/embed/guard/tts/… utilities), persists it via update_state, and uses it. If a saved model later 404s, it is cleared and rediscovered, retrying once.
bugs.prevention: Never hardcode cloud model IDs — discover from /models and persist the choice. Keep the _NON_CHAT_RE filter updated when adding utility-style models.

bugs.symptom: Sidebar chat history disappeared after every server restart.
bugs.root_cause: Same class of bug as BF-010: sessions were an in-memory list only.
bugs.fix: _chat_state now loads/saves the 'chat_sessions' section of .harness-state.json on create/append/delete.
bugs.prevention: See rules_for_agents[0] — user-visible state must be a persisted section; session tests still pass against a temp file via conftest.

bugs.symptom: Chat showed the raw tool-call block instead of an answer — e.g. `<tool_call>{"tool_calls": [{"name": "fetch_url", "arguments": {"url": "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Strobilanthes_kunthiana", "max_chars": 5000}}]}</tool_call>` rendered literally in the reply.
bugs.root_cause: Qwen/Anthropic-style models emit tool calls wrapped in <tool_call>…</tool_call> XML rather than the bare JSON the system prompt documented. Extraction worked, but _clean_final_text only stripped the wrapper TAGS — the inner JSON payload (and any repeated tool-call block) still leaked into the visible reply and session history; and when a model only ever emitted tool calls, the loop returned that raw text as the 'answer'.
bugs.fix: (1) _clean_final_text now removes whole <tool_call>…</tool_call> blocks (tags + inner JSON), stray tags, and any bare tool-call JSON payloads via a JSON-decoder scan; (2) an empty result falls back to a friendly note instead of dumping markup; (3) the system prompt documents both the JSON and <tool_call> forms and forbids the markup in the final answer; (4) loop/parser.classify strips the same wrapper tags so the CLI loop matches. Added tests in tests/test_ui.py and tests/test_loop_e2e.py.
bugs.prevention: See rules_for_agents[11]; whenever a tool-call format is accepted, verify the corresponding cleanup strips it from the final text and add a regression test for the exact raw string that leaked.

bugs.symptom: Chat repeatedly returned "I gathered information with my browsing tools, but couldn't produce a clean summary this time…" even though tools ran — the model's answer was being truncated by a low output-token ceiling, or the model kept requesting tools up to the round cap so no final answer was ever produced.
bugs.root_cause: Two compounding problems: (1) no way to raise the output-token ceiling (max_tokens was never sent to the endpoint, so providers applied a low default that cut answers short); (2) the tool loop broke on the last round whenever the model still emitted a tool call, leaving an empty reply that hit the BF-013 fallback message.
bugs.fix: Added a Generation tab in AI Provider (STEP 3) with Max output tokens + Context window controls, persisted in ai_provider state and wired end-to-end: LLMClient.chat/stream_chat now forward max_tokens; routes_chat passes max_tokens from state and _fit_context trims the transcript to the context_window; save_provider coerces/clears these fields via model_fields_set; and the loop now runs a final tool round then forces one explicit 'provide the final answer' turn instead of emitting the fallback. Added tests (test_llm_client, test_ai_integration, test_ui).
bugs.prevention: See rules_for_agents[12]; always surface generation limits as user-tunable, persisted settings — never silently cap output, and never let an empty answer surface when one more explicit turn would produce it.
